part.text: The fix is validated. Final state of the change:

Fixed `SegmentInfos.replace()` in lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/index/SegmentInfos.java:1013 to propagate `userData` from `other`.

Validation (Gradle suite couldn't run — the container has no network, no complete Gradle distribution, and no JUnit/randomizedtesting jars):
- Compiled all of `lucene/core/src/java` with javac: clean.
- End-to-end check reproducing the issue scenario (two commits with different user data, `IndexWriter` opened from the older `IndexCommit`, which calls `segmentInfos.replace()`):
  - Without the fix: `AssertionError: expected ... [commit=first], got [commit=second]`
  - With the fix: `OK ... [commit=first]`

This matches the upstream apache/lucene#12626 one-line fix.
